title: 第一卷 第334章 恶龙扑猫第一卷 第333章 是你的宝宝吗你就都手动脚
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了
content_zh:
推荐各位书友阅读：笨蛋美人当团宠，师兄们抢疯了！
第一卷第334章恶龙扑猫（..la）最终，苍恹没有夺回舒晩昭体内的气运，并且还赔给了她一部分，统哥检查出来她体内的龙族气运明显增强了。
舒晩昭震惊够呛。
有龙族气运对她的身体更好，但是她第一反应不是：这败家的爷们，有点气运不知道咋嘚瑟好了、
舒晩昭恨铁不成钢了、
忙碌了一天，回到家她都还在生气，最后忍无可忍，一手将男龙推到墙上，手抵住他的胸膛偏下点，她气咻咻地道：“你变成原形，要缩小的。”
别问为什么要按着他胸膛往下的位置，还不是因为这厮百年后虽然经常穿衣服没有再半人半蛇的裸奔，但穿得很不正经，领口高开叉的那种，谁知道会不会突然开个衩，直接肌肤和肌肤相处。
到时候这条龙黏上来找她负责，她上哪哭去。
所以此时此刻，她按在男人腹部，揪住了那层布料，狠狠命令，“现在，立刻，马上，给我变回龙形！”
漂亮的小脸蛋鼓得像猫嘴努，呆毛高高竖起，几缕服帖的头发拂过光洁的额头，再往下是高高竖起的小眉头，以及愤怒小鸟的大眼睛，明亮如星辰的眼眸此时正冒着小火苗。
苍恹视角她就是：，带毛绒绒妙脆角的那种。
他浓密修长的睫毛垂落，凤眸下移，紫色的瞳仁倒映着某个小家伙莫名其妙生气的模样。
从将气运给她开始，她就已经这样了。
舒晩昭还在：
大概是长时间没有得到回应，已经逐渐不耐烦，所以就这样：
两眼一眯，充满危险，小脾气一爆炸，还挺唬人的。
像苍恹这种雄性，龙中霸总，他勾唇一笑，一手搭在她的肩头，修长、骨节分明的手指卷着她柔软的发丝：“我若不呢？跳起来打我脑袋？”
她能将他怎样？
他就是仗着自己皮糙肉厚，舒晩昭打不疼他。
但是……

舒晩昭有的是力气和手段，当反派这一块儿，她手拿把掐，就不信还教训不了一条龙了。
【？？？】
系统不认同，但是它的宿主一向很有自己的想法，十个系统都拉不回来那种。
只见它家宿主十分霸气地一手叉腰，一手薅住龙的领子，一脸桀桀桀，“你不变成小龙，一会我就出去把你的龙族气运弄出去喂狗。”
【（￣（エ）￣）……】
苍恹：“……”
他愣了几秒，然后低低地闷笑，“是吗？那可太坏了，我都害怕了哦。”
舒晩昭狐疑地瞅他两眼，却见男子笑成了弯了杆的霸王花，妖冶昳丽的脸上全是笑意，眼尾好像还笑出了……泪水？
完全没有半点害怕的模样。
舒晩昭开始怀疑人生，怎么个事儿，她都作恶三百章了，电视剧都演到大结局了，人都要领便当了，竟然还桀桀不到人。
生气。
恼怒。

Volume 1 Chapter 334 The evil dragon attacks the cat (..la) In the end, Cang Xian did not take back the luck in Shu Mingzhao's body, and even compensated her part of it. Brother Tong checked that the dragon's luck in her body was significantly enhanced.
Shu Mingzhao was shocked.
Having dragon luck would be better for her health, but her first reaction was not: This prodigal man has some luck, so he doesn't know what to do with it.
Shu Mingzhao hated that iron could not become steel.
After a busy day, she was still angry when she got home. Finally, she couldn't bear it anymore. She pushed the male dragon against the wall with one hand and put her hand on the lower part of his chest. She said angrily: "You will become your original shape and you will shrink."
Don't ask why you pressed down on his chest. It's not because after a hundred years, this guy often wears clothes and no longer runs naked like a half-man, half-snake, but he still wears very immodest clothes, with a high slit at the neckline. Who knows if he will suddenly open a slit to directly connect skin to skin.
When the time comes when this dragon comes to take responsibility for her, where will she cry?
So at this moment, she pressed on the man's abdomen, grabbed the layer of fabric, and ordered fiercely, "Now, immediately, immediately, change back to the dragon form for me!"
The beautiful little face is as bulging as a cat's mouth, the hair is raised high, a few strands of hair brushing the smooth forehead, and then there are the raised brows, and the big eyes of Angry Birds, the eyes as bright as stars are burning with small flames at this time.
From Cang Huan's perspective, she is the kind with fluffy and crispy corners.
His thick and slender eyelashes drooped, his phoenix eyes moved downward, and his purple pupils reflected the inexplicable angry look of a certain little guy.
She has been like this ever since the luck was given to her.
Shu Mingzhao is still here:
Probably because I haven’t received a response for a long time, I have become impatient, so here it is:
When his eyes are narrowed, he is full of danger, and when his temper explodes, he is quite bluffing.
For a male like Cang Huan, the tyrant among dragons, he smiled, put a hand on her shoulder, and curled her soft hair with his long, well-jointed fingers: "What if I don't? Jump up and hit me on the head?"
What can she do to him?
He just relied on his rough skin and thick flesh to prevent Shu Manzhao from hurting him.
But...
Shu Mingzhao is full of strength and means. When it comes to being a villain, she can't believe that she can't teach a dragon a lesson.
【? ? ? 】
The system doesn't agree with it, but its host has always had its own ideas, and even ten systems can't bring it back.
I saw its host very domineeringly put one hand on his hips and held the dragon's collar with the other, with a arrogant look on his face, "If you don't turn into a little dragon, I will go out in a while to get your dragon luck out and feed it to the dogs."
【（￣（エ）￣）……】
Cang Yan: "..."
He was stunned for a few seconds, then chuckled lowly, "Really? That's so bad, I'm even scared."
Shu Mingzhao glanced at him suspiciously, but saw that the man's smile turned into a bent-over flower. His charming and beautiful face was full of smiles, and there seemed to be tears in his eyes from laughter?
There was no look of fear at all.
Shu Mingzhao began to doubt life. She had been doing evil for three hundred chapters, and the TV series had reached its finale. Everyone was about to take advantage of it, but she was still so stubborn.
angry.
angry.
